ticket_text: I was charged twice for my October subscription and need one refunded.
resolution_summary: Confirmed the duplicate October charge and issued a refund for the extra subscription payment; it will post in 3-5 business days.

ticket_text: The export button throws a 500 error every time I click it.
resolution_summary: Reproduced the 500 on export, traced it to a timeout in the report service, deployed a fix, and verified export now completes.

ticket_text: I can't log in, it says my account is locked after a password reset.
resolution_summary: Unlocked the account that was flagged by the reset flow and sent a fresh reset link; confirmed the customer logged in successfully.

ticket_text: My invoice shows the wrong company name and I need it corrected.
resolution_summary: Updated the billing profile company name and reissued the corrected invoice PDF for the current period.

ticket_text: The mobile app crashes on startup after the latest update.
resolution_summary: Identified a null-state crash on cold start in the latest build, shipped a hotfix, and confirmed the app launches cleanly.

ticket_text: I was promised a 20% discount but it wasn't applied at checkout.
resolution_summary: Found the missing promo on the order, applied the 20% discount retroactively, and refunded the difference to the card on file.

ticket_text: API returns 401 even with a freshly generated key.
resolution_summary: Found the new key was scoped to the wrong project; regenerated it with the correct scope and confirmed authenticated calls succeed.

ticket_text: Please delete my account and all associated data per my request.
resolution_summary: Verified identity, queued the account and associated data for deletion within 30 days, and sent written confirmation.

ticket_text: You charged my old card instead of the new one I added.

ticket_text: Search results are completely empty even for exact title matches.
resolution_summary: Found the search index had not rebuilt after migration; triggered a reindex and confirmed exact-title queries return results.

ticket_text: I need to transfer ownership of the workspace to a colleague.
resolution_summary: Transferred workspace ownership to the specified colleague after admin confirmation and verified their new owner permissions.

ticket_text: The dashboard shows last week's numbers, not today's.
resolution_summary: Traced stale dashboard data to a broken nightly ETL job, re-ran it, and confirmed the dashboard now reflects today's numbers.

ticket_text: Cancel my plan; I do not want to be billed next cycle.
